attributes.has_name: Assess state machine formal verification feasibility
attributes.task_description: Evaluate if formal methods (model checking) can prove absence of deadlock in TigerDetectionApp state machine.
Review rain/light/obstruction detection algorithms. Are all ISO 21448 triggering conditions covered? Gap analysis needed.
Measure time from fault injection to safe state indication on HMI. Must complete within T_warning under worst-case scheduling.
Design test verifying alarm output stays within L_alarm_min to L_alarm_max after component aging (speaker degradation, amplifier drift).

attributes.has_name: Define camera driver fault notification mechanism
attributes.task_description: Define how CameraDriverLayer signals fault conditions (frame loss, init failure, timing violation) to downstream consumers and system health manager. Specify DTC reporting and validity flag behavior.

attributes.has_name: Define sensor fusion integration test scenarios
attributes.task_description: Define integration test scenarios for SensorFusionMiddleware covering all environmental conditions to validate P_fn_close and P_fn_mid.
Analyze scenarios where both LiDAR and IR degrade simultaneously (dense vegetation, extreme temperature). Assess residual detection capability.

attributes.has_name: Investigate ML model robustness under SOTIF conditions
attributes.task_description: Analyze classification model performance under partial occlusion, camouflage, and unusual thermal signatures. Determine if additional training data is needed.
